text: CLI, MCP, and direct Python use the same fluent_pipeline services.
The documented workflow starts with bootstrap status and requires project import plus inspection before generation.
Offline ready-to-import validation does not claim Script Editor or hardware readiness.

Shallow tecan.driver_macros.v1 stays inventory-only; per-usage DriverFramework parameter contracts live in adjacent tecan.driver_command_contracts.v1 with exact selection or deterministic ambiguity failure.
The normal full-export-plus-request path is owned by the shared application_services.run_one_shot service and preserves the existing generation workflow.

Generation-context compaction keeps critical structured evidence atomic, preserves duplicate candidate metadata, records explicit budget accounting and omissions, and supports byte, character, and estimated-token limits.
Repair-delta generation context includes only implicated diagnostics, source lineage, relevant contracts, and explicitly safe repair actions; full logs and unrelated catalogs are excluded.

The shared generation workflow ranks source scripts and mined patterns, emits bounded context artifacts, and carries their fingerprint and review status through IR, manifests, hashes, and packaged reports.
FluentControl expression semantics use the versioned tecan.expression_symbols.v1 catalog and shared catalog services for validation, inventory, generation policy, and symbol introspection.

Canonical Protocol IR v2 carries source-backed Move Axis, Start Move, and Wait For Async Response sequences through XSCR ingestion and generated FluentCoder Python while preserving typed fields, ordering, provenance, line metadata, and additive XML.

Target-aware deployment plans use one shared application_services.plan_deployment service over explicit source/target profiles; the CLI is a thin adapter and planning never mutates a target or promotes runtime/database metadata.

MCA pickup XSCR ingestion preserves source-backed coordinates, offsets, orientation, and tip-position expressions through typed parser, renderer, and decompiler round-trips; additive fields outside the typed contract remain source-preserved rather than inferred.

Canonical project ingestion preserves Base Worktable name/GUID provenance with deterministic ambiguity, keeps Scheduler process/task entities separate from GWL worklists, and parses TWL Task Input records with source order and additive fields retained.

Subroutine execution modes use one verified four-value contract; authored API values reject unknown modes while decompiled future modes remain source-preserved, and target identity is classified conservatively without guessing dynamic names.

Offline simulator subroutine lifecycle analysis models deterministic launch, join, and detached epochs without threads or hardware; matching joins consume outstanding asynchronous invocations, and unmatched, detached, unknown, or still-outstanding states remain actionable findings.

The shared command registry maps verified Move Axis, Start Move, and Wait For Async Response statements to canonical Protocol IR operations with typed field aliases; unsupported variants remain unmapped and other low-level driver commands remain passthrough.
